about: Frozen T27 query set. Every idea was written for this evaluation; none comes from a real user, a log or a transcript, and none contains personal data. Change an idea only by adding a new id, so earlier judgments stay comparable. Categories: common = popular topics; rare = niche topics; language = names a language, framework or platform; non_english = written in another language; no_match = no real project is expected to fit.
